shared_elements: large wings with rows of overlapping feathers rendered as repeated scalloped units
frontal/symmetrical or profile hybrid being (human body with bird attributes)
justification: Both depict a winged composite being combining human arms/hands with large feathered wings, the feathers in both rendered as ordered rows of repeated scalloped/overlapping units, and both show a fringed or banded garment element at the waist. The biggest difference is orientation and composition: A shows a profile human-headed figure with bearded head, one arm raised holding an object, wings behind and a long robed body, while B is a strictly symmetrical frontal bird-headed being with both wings spread outward, a beak and eye, and bosses on the chest.
